sentences.en: A long train of camels was moving to the west.
sentences.zh: 一列长长的骆驼正向西移动。

sentences.en: If you go near a camel, you risk being bitten.
sentences.zh: 如果你靠近骆驼，可能会被咬。

sentences.en: This camel is so tame that anyone can ride it.
sentences.zh: 这头骆驼很温顺，任何人都可以骑它。

senses.zh: [畜牧][脊椎] 骆驼；打捞浮筒；工作作风官僚
